evidence: It takes a minimum of three days to complete and can be walked in either direction.
The directions in this guide take you from the true right of the Waiotukupuna Bridge (SH38), 16 km west of the Aniwaniwa Visitor Centre.
From the shelter there is an easy downhill walk to the end of the track, 200 m west of the Visitor Centre.

evidence: If you wish to see more of the area, there is a detour you can take through the Ruapani wetlands.
Instead of taking the track to Waikareiti Shelter, take a fork to the right, approximately 2 hours 30 minutes to the south of the Sandy Bay Hut.
At the end of the track turn right to reach the start of the Waikareiti Track on SH38.

doubts: Start: the text starts from the Waiotukupuna Bridge on SH38, taken as F1 (Manuoha Track meets Waikaremoana Road; SH38 not named as that road in the text). W2 time 7 hr is the heading time for the Sandy Bay to Aniwaniwa alternative section only; W2 end F3 (Ruapani Track meets road) is my inference for 'the end of the track', after which one turns right to reach the Waikareiti Track start on SH38. Manuoha Hut is being removed. Waikareiti Shelter has no bunks, not listed as hut. Walkable in either direction (not a separate way).
